benefit_text: The scheme gives loans up to ₹10,000 to street vendors to restart and expand business. The interest rate is 7%. No collateral is needed. No processing fee is charged. The repayment period is one year.
who_can_apply: Street vendors with Certificate of Vending or Identity Card from Urban Local Bodies can apply. Vendors identified in the survey but without the certificate or card can also apply. Vendors with a Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Bodies or Town Vending Committee can apply.
documents: Important papers are Certificate of Vending, Identity Card and Letter of Recommendation. Aadhaar Card and PAN Card are also needed as identity proof.
how_to_apply: Applications can be made online and offline. The form is filled online with vendor category and Survey Reference Number. Relevant documents are uploaded and the form is submitted.
